name: orbrey-ai
description: 12 skills + 3 agents + 6 commands for running an Orbrey household — meal planning, grocery, chores, routines, family scheduling, calendar conflicts, and rewards. Includes kitchen-concierge, which places real grocery orders through your own Chrome session behind a code-enforced spend ceiling. Connects to the orbrey-mcp Cloudflare Worker over HTTP with OAuth handled by Claude Code.

default_household_id.title: Default household UUID (optional)
default_household_id.description: Optional. When you have multiple households, set this to skip the disambiguation prompt. Otherwise the worker auto-resolves the household from your active grants. You can also set this server-side via the households.set_default MCP tool, which persists across sessions.
